title: Wo Jia Da Shixiong Naozi You Keng

synonyms: There's a Pit in My Senior Martial Brother's Brain
Our Big Brother's Mind Has A Problem
alternative_titles.en: What's Wrong with My Big Brother

synopsis:
After transmigrating into a cultivation world and becoming the eldest disciple of the Xiaoyao Sect, Dongfang Xianyun discovers that he doesn’t fit the mold of a typical protagonist from a transmigration novel. Following a few experiments, he decides that his best chance for survival is to latch onto his second junior brother, Yin Feixing—who perfectly embodies the classic protagonist archetype. The story follows the chaotic and uproarious life at the Xiaoyao Sect, featuring Dongfang Xianyun, the "protagonist" Yin Feixing, their eccentric third junior sister, and their lively, adorable youngest junior brother.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
